vulnerable_code:
class WorkspaceSerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :name, :plan_tier

  # Exposes private corporate transactions to read-only project guests
  has_many :billing_transactions
end

class WorkspacesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    workspace = Workspace.find(params[:id])
    render json: workspace
  end
end
diagnosis: WorkspaceSerializer embeds billing_transactions on the workspace object without restricting access to organization billing admins. External guests invited to view specific workspace boards can extract complete corporate credit card receipts and tax identifiers.
exploit_request:
GET /api/workspaces/ws_1102 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.cloudboards.io
Authorization: Bearer guest_collaborator_token_31
Accept: application/json
corrected_code:
class WorkspaceSerializer < ActiveModel::Serializer
  attributes :id, :name, :plan_tier

  has_many :billing_transactions, if: :can_view_financials?

  def can_view_financials?
    scope&.billing_admin_for?(object)
  end
end

class WorkspacesController < ApplicationController
  def show
    workspace = Workspace.find(params[:id])
    render json: workspace
  end
end
